title: World Bloom — Turning Pain Into Drive

meta.Outline: The members of Vivid BAD SQUAD check in on the tree growing in the plaza of their SEKAI. Suddenly, each of them is thrown into a dream showing them a different life, in a world where their paths diverged...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, let's stop here for today.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You all seemed pretty solid today.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You can't beat singing in SEKAI.
No other place gives you this sense of comfort, you know?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Maybe it's because we can relax while we sing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Especially since things feel so different overseas.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: On top of being in an unfamiliar place, we're dealing with a new climate. It's hard not to feel uncomfortable with the drastic change in temperature and humidity.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, I guess that's why everything sounds different as a result.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Now I'm curious to know how it's different.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I've heard that some artists go abroad in order to record their music.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, I was just marveling at just how much they've all grown.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You were already steadily improving before traveling overseas, but I feel like you've all been finding new gears since then.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I don't think we're doing that well.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
But I understand what KAITO is trying to say.
It's clear that you've all absorbed quite a lot based on the way you're singing.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Which would explain why that tree has been growing so fast.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That tree...?
Are you talking about the one in the plaza?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Speaking of which, it was but a little sprout not too long ago. Now, it's become quite a robust specimen.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Normally, it'd take a lot longer for a tree to reach that stage.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You must all be accelerating its growth.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey, why don't we all go check up on it together?!
It might've grown even bigger since then!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, let's go! I wanna see it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay, why not?
I don't really have any other plans today.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Then, that's perfect!
We can all go over together!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They are always watering it. I think they especially want to see it grow big and strong.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see... That's quite the commitment.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, I also water it! Sometimes!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then, you two also deserve some credit.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Honestly, you both just want to hear some praise...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What's taking so long, you guys?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, hurry up! Look how big it's—

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...
And its leaves are all drooping...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
But why?!
It was full of life just yesterday!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Is it possible for it to get sick?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, plants can become sick...
But not this quickly, from what I understand.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It would seem that the tree itself hasn't turned black.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. Upon closer inspection, I'm seeing all these black fragments coating it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right!
What are these things...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: These black things weren't here yesterday, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And its leaves all looked really healthy!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. We have no proof at this point...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But these black fragments appear to be the reason why this tree looks so sickly now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. I mean, you can tell that they're bad news just from looking at them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We have nothing to go on right now, but we should focus on helping this tree.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What if we picked the fragments off...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm worried that the tree's going to get even sicker if we don't.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, let's give it a whirl!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, all of them? Is that even possible...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The ones on the ends of the branches seem like the easiest to remove.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I thought I heard someone calling my name just now...)

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line:
“What are you saying?
Our next class is about to start.”

rows.Speaker: Male Student B
rows.Line: “Haha. Mr. Hermut's history lectures are usually pretty boring, so I don't blame you for dozing off.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(They're speaking German...?
And the view outside this window...)

rows.Speaker: Male Student B
rows.Line:
“Are you sure you're feeling okay, Toya?
You really seem out of it.”

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line: “Wait, you're not sick, are you?! Now I feel terrible for waking you!”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “I was...having a bit of an odd dream just now.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “Yes, so I'm glad you woke me up.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “Mr. Hermut's lectures are very interesting, so I'd rather not miss a second of it.”

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line:
“You're such a good student, Toya!
Are all kids in Japan like you?”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “I can't speak for my peers, but... I suppose we are a studious bunch.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “Plus, I'm here because I chose to be.”

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
“Rationalism and natural science.
As these two schools of thought gained traction throughout Europe, people's core values began to change.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I've been in Vienna as an exchange student for a while now.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Keeping up with these lectures has been challenging, but I know I'm receiving a high-quality education.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And Mom is the reason why I've been able to focus on my studies like this.)

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: You stayed out late again? Where were you?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: Let me guess. You were at an arcade or some other frivolous place.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father
rows.Line: How many times do I have to tell you that you can't afford to waste time like this?

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father's Voice
rows.Line: Just when I thought that he'd given up on that nonsense music, he's still acting like a hooligan. Not only can't I hold a decent conversation with him, he refuses to have dinner with us...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Father's Voice
rows.Line: Honestly, what does that boy want to do with his life?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Now I know.
Neither classical nor street music...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I...wasn't meant to pursue either of them in the first place.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I've been surrounded by music my entire life and told that I had to become a musician...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I feel like I'm being lambasted here every day.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Even though I can't do anything anymore.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Even breathing is hard for me at this point...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I no longer belong in this house.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line:
I brought you your dinner.
I'll leave it right here, so please have however much you feel like.

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: There's something I've been meaning to ask you for a little while now...

rows.Speaker: Toya's Mother
rows.Line: How would you like to go somewhere new...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (After Mom suggested that to me, I immediately decided to leave home and live with Natsuomi.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Not only do I enjoy learning new things, but foreign cultures have always interested me.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I can focus on studying without having to worry about anything else.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, Natsuomi is still performing in that concert.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I thought I'd cause him a lot of trouble by moving in with him...but he's been so busy that we haven't actually seen each other all that much.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That might be to both our benefits.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Anyway, I should start making dinner.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The meat's too chewy. I think I overcooked it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
And the soup tastes bland...
I also should've cut these vegetables into smaller, bite-sized pieces. I still have a long way to go.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I never would've imagined being able to cook my own meals when I was still playing classical music.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (In that sense, I feel like I've made quite a bit of progress in terms of learning to lead a normal life.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I have to believe...that I made the right choice.

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line:
“You're not gonna believe this, Toya!
I got a horrible score on that test for music class...”

rows.Speaker: Male Student B
rows.Line: “He's been asked to sing in front of the entire class, and he has to improve his music skills before then.”

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line: “How am I supposed to do that?! I'm totally tone deaf!”

rows.Speaker: Male Student B
rows.Line: “But you have to do this... Oh, wait.”

rows.Speaker: Male Student B
rows.Line:
“Why don't you ask Toya for some tips?
If I recall, he always gets amazing grades in music.”

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line:
“Hey, that's right!
You got any good advice for me, Toya?!”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
“Well...
First, if you wish to improve your pitch...”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
“...but those are the only remedies that come to mind.
I only hope that some of that was helpful.”

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line: “That's amazing, Toya! You're a total pro!”

rows.Speaker: Male Student B
rows.Line: “Yeah. I'd heard that you used to be a pretty serious musician, but you're more knowledgeable than I even imagined.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
“I'm really nothing special.
And I've quit playing music.”

rows.Speaker: Male Student B
rows.Line: “I know, right? Now I really wanna hear you sing, Toya.”

rows.Speaker: Male Student B
rows.Line: “Do you have any plans to give it another go?”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
“Nothing bad happened per se.
It just wasn't for me. That's all.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “Yes, things were hard at times, but...”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “My memories of that time all feel like a dream now.”

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line:
“We had no idea...
Also, you seem to really enjoy talking about all that.”

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line: “I feel like you should give it another try.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(A message?
From who...? Oh, it's some of my old classmates from Kamiyama High.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I wasn't expecting a message like that.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (They invited me to a get-together for old time's sake.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(But what do I do...?
I came all the way back without sending a reply.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I can't let this drag on forever...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
...!
Natsuomi... I didn't realize you were home...

rows.Speaker: Natsuomi
rows.Line: Yes, I'm back. Did anything happen while I was gone?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Nothing to report. And congratulations on your concert. I'll get dinner ready now.

rows.Speaker: Natsuomi
rows.Line: No, I'll cook tonight. It's been a while since I last did.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, then... I'll set the table.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
This is good.
You really are a much better cook than me.

rows.Speaker: Natsuomi
rows.Line: To be fair, I can't make anything all that fancy.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Fun.
But I can't let my guard down because of all the tests they've been giving us.

rows.Speaker: Natsuomi
rows.Line: As long as you pay attention during class each day, you should be able to achieve good results. But it's also important to read ahead and review what you've already covered.

rows.Speaker: Natsuomi
rows.Line: You seem rather despondent. Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Natsuomi
rows.Line: If there's something on your mind, then I'll be more than happy to listen.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: My friends from Japan contacted me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We were classmates when we were first-years, and they invited me to gather with them for old time's sake. It'd be nice to go, but...

rows.Speaker: Natsuomi
rows.Line: Then, you should go. What's holding you back?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I know. But the thing is...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm not sure if I should.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm worried that my old street-music teammate is also going to be there.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I didn't fully commit the way he needed me to, which ended up hurting him...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I doubt he'll want to see my face.

rows.Speaker: Natsuomi
rows.Line: Do you dislike him now, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Natsuomi
rows.Line: You just said that he probably wouldn't want to see you.

rows.Speaker: Natsuomi
rows.Line: So, do you feel the same way about him?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I feel too ashamed to show my face.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Because he taught me just how much fun singing can be.

rows.Speaker: Natsuomi
rows.Line: I understand why you feel conflicted.

rows.Speaker: Natsuomi
rows.Line: However, you both love music and were working towards the same goal. So, I believe you'll be able to find some common ground.

rows.Speaker: Natsuomi
rows.Line: Also, the look on your face just now is all the more reason why you should tell him how you feel.

rows.Speaker: Natsuomi
rows.Line: That was the look of someone who cares deeply about something.

rows.Speaker: Natsuomi
rows.Line:
This is all the advice I can give you.
My hope is that you don't regret any decisions you make...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (What just happened? Everything went blurry all of a sudden...)

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
“Hey, Akito, you okay?
You're on soon.”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Wait, of course he is...
I'm in the US.)

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: “Whoa, don't go collapsing on stage or anything, okay?”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
“I'm fine.
And this crowd won't know what hit them.”

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
“Seems like it.
He's really young, but he sounds pretty good.”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (No, I can still do better. A lot better...!)

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: “You had them bouncing off the walls, Akito!”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Yeah, the crowd reacted pretty well...
I still remember the crickets I heard when I first came over here.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (In that sense, things have gotten a lot better...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But this still isn't enough to surpass RAD WEEKEND.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I need to learn how to get the crowd going even more and improve my technique...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: “Yeah, I still need to finish my training routine for today.”

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
“You're so diligent.
But why not hang out with some other musicians for a change?”

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: “Sam and the others were just looking for you. They wanted to see if you'd be interested in going to the after-party.”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Actually, I might learn something new by talking to other musicians.)

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: “You put on another great performance today.”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: “I appreciate you saying that, but I still have a lot of work left to do.”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: “I mean, what's the point if I can't get everyone in the place fired up?”

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line:
“Haha. You don't sound satisfied at all.
I like that hungry spirit of yours!”

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line:
“I really admire your work ethic.
I still remember when you could barely get two words out in English...”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: “That doesn't matter now since I'm a way better speaker now...”

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: “Still, Akito, you've grown so much in a lot of different respects.”

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: “I agree. Every time we watch you perform, we're stunned by how much you've grown since the last time.”

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: “So, Akito, how would you feel about teaming up with us?”

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line:
“Whoa, that was fast!
You won't even try it out for a little bit?”

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: “You aren't helping things by being so overbearing.”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: “I've already decided that I'm not going to team up with anyone.”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If they couldn't make it through that, then that means they've reached their ceiling.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If they're not committed like we are, they're never going to surpass RAD WEEKEND. Right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We have to forget about them and keep moving forward, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? What are you talking about?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I can't keep going after this childish dream.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (At first, I thought his dad was behind what he said.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (And by the time I calmed down and felt ready to talk to him, he'd left Japan.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (No, what's done is done. There's no use thinking about this any further...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I just have to keep singing. Alone.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Because... I think that's the best way for me to rise to the top.)

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: “Why did you decide to start singing over here, Akito? Are you chasing after a particular artist or something?”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: “There's an event that I want to surpass...”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: “Yes. An event that I'm willing to spend my entire life on trying to surpass.”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: “I'm focused on doing just that right now.”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I thought I heard someone else's voice just now.)

rows.Speaker: Friend B
rows.Line:
Whoa, you're really here?
When did you get back to Japan?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Just last night.
I couldn't sleep because there was so much turbulence during my flight.

rows.Speaker: Friend B
rows.Line:
Haha. But you seem fine despite that.
I guess it's a testament to your stamina.

rows.Speaker: Friend A
rows.Line:
Aoyagi also came back to Japan!
What country was it? Australia?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Austria. I'm currently living in Vienna.

rows.Speaker: Friend A
rows.Line:
Yeah, there!
And Akito's over in the US. It's so amazing what you guys are doing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm singing over in the States right now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I had no idea you were still singing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Is he implying that I'm still chasing after a childish dream?)

rows.Speaker: Friend B
rows.Line: Anyway, now that we're all here, let's head over to the diner, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Friend A
rows.Line: Still, I sort of can't believe that you're taking time off from school to be in America.

rows.Speaker: Friend A
rows.Line: Do you miss Japanese food at all?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh... No, I haven't been feeling all that homesick. I mean, they have Japanese food over there.

rows.Speaker: Friend B
rows.Line: Really? You're living with your big brother right now, Aoyagi?

rows.Speaker: Friend B
rows.Line: That's nice. I'd be so scared if I had to live abroad all by myself.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, his support has been enormous.

rows.Speaker: Friend A
rows.Line: Hey, don't you wanna trade stories with Aoyagi about what it's like to live overseas...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? What's gotten into you all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Friend A
rows.Line:
Well, I mean...
You guys used to be best buds before, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, how have things been for you lately?

rows.Speaker: Friend A
rows.Line:
Oh, you wanna know?
After a certain someone decided to leave, we've been having a ton of trouble finding people who are willing to lend the soccer team a hand.

rows.Speaker: Friend B
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Aoyagi, you used to play music pretty seriously.

rows.Speaker: Friend B
rows.Line: Does that mean you're going to a music school now?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, I'm attending a normal school.

rows.Speaker: Friend B
rows.Line: What?! Really? But you're such an amazing singer!

rows.Speaker: Friend A
rows.Line: Yeah! You're giving it up for good? That seems like such a waste.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I appreciate you saying that, and I'm sorry to disappoint you, but... I've made my decision.

rows.Speaker: Friend B
rows.Line: Alright... But I guess that's only natural if you found something else you wanna do.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I can't keep going after this childish dream.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I've got no clue what he's thinking...)

rows.Speaker: Friend A
rows.Line:
Man, that was great!
It was so fun to hang out like this again!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. Oh, it's already this late?

rows.Speaker: Friend B
rows.Line: We really chatted up a storm, huh?

rows.Speaker: Friend A
rows.Line:
We should do this again sometime!
We'll make sure to invite you two again, Akito, Aoyagi!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you. I'll make an effort to attend if I'm free.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure, if I can make it.

rows.Speaker: Friend A
rows.Line: That's a promise! Anyway, see you guys!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It's my last chance for us to talk.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (He probably sees me as a complete stranger now, but...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I've been gone for a while, so I'm gonna go for a stroll before I head home. Later.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Can we talk for a minute?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: There's something I need to tell you.

rows.Speaker: Music Teacher
rows.Line:
We will now begin our singing test.
Starting with you, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Female Student A
rows.Line: I can't wait to hear Hoshino sing.

rows.Speaker: Female Student B
rows.Line: I know this is a test, but how cool is it that we get to hear a pro sing in person?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Her voice has this intense power and beauty to it... Just listening to her makes my heart dance.)

rows.Speaker: Female Student B
rows.Line:
That was awesome, Hoshino!
Can we get an encore?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It's incredible how she can sing with such confidence.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Father's Voice
rows.Line:
Umm...
You looked sad for some reason when you got back.

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Father's Voice
rows.Line: I know. You should come down to the living room once you've settled down. We got sesame balls... I know they're your favorite.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(I'm so embarrassed...
Everything that I've been doing...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I've been causing An, Dad and a lot of other people so much worry...)

rows.Speaker: Female Student A
rows.Line: Yeah! I didn't know she was such a good singer...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I hope I don't sound too shaky...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I guess I'm still...afraid of singing in front of people...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (This is the precious gift An gave me.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm going to sing with that feeling in mind.)

rows.Speaker: Female Student A
rows.Line: That was amazing, Azusawa! You were so good!

rows.Speaker: Female Student B
rows.Line: We had no idea that you could sing like that!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Your voice, Azusawa...
It was beautiful and sounded so crystal clear. You had me on the edge of my seat the whole time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
N-No, I...
I'm really nothing special...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, but I am glad that you liked my singing. And thank you for the compliment...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Music class ended up being kind of fun.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (As nervous as I was, I managed to sing all the way until the end...)

rows.Speaker: Music Teacher
rows.Line: Do you have a minute, Azusawa?

rows.Speaker: Music Teacher
rows.Line: I'd like to ask for a favor.

rows.Speaker: Music Teacher
rows.Line: The thing is, the school is going to be hosting a music festival in the near future.

rows.Speaker: Music Teacher
rows.Line: And I'm currently looking for singers to perform at it.

rows.Speaker: Music Teacher
rows.Line: You don't have to if you're not comfortable, but how would you feel about joining?

rows.Speaker: Music Teacher
rows.Line: I mean, the way you sang just now was absolutely spectacular.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Singing at a music festival means performing on stage, right...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (That voice... It felt so familiar for some—)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I also want to keep moving forward.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Normally, I'd practice somewhere closer to the station since there's usually more people...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(No, don't rush yourself...
All you've been doing is singing by yourself in your room...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I have to start by getting used to singing in public.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let's see... I can play my music through my phone's speakers...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (After that event, An sent me a lot of messages.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (If I can't sing on stage, then surpassing a legendary event...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Making An's dream come true... I can't do any of that.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm still nowhere near her level.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (An made my heart race every time I heard her sing...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I had so much fun whenever we sang together. I thought anything was possible for us...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And I was so happy when she started calling me her partner.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I know it's probably too late now.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I thought I'd be able to come here early today since we didn't have classes...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But my committee duties ended up taking longer than expected.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's been so long since I last came here.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Even if it's from afar, I have a feeling that hearing An's voice will help motivate me more.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (This place... I'm still a little scared of it...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I never felt afraid whenever I was with An, but...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(I'll be fine...
As long as I walk off towards the side, no one should notice me...)
Huh? Hey, aren't you that girl who was always singing with An?

rows.Speaker: Live House Staff A
rows.Line:
Hey, don't scare her like that.
Sorry, we didn't mean to startle you.

rows.Speaker: Live House Staff B
rows.Line:
I-I'm really sorry...!
I sort of couldn't help it after I realized that you were An's partner...

rows.Speaker: Live House Staff A
rows.Line:
You two were such a great duo.
Despite having starkly different personalities, you were able to draw the best out of each other.

rows.Speaker: Live House Staff B
rows.Line: Yeah, and An's been singing all by herself recently. It'd be great to see you to sing together again.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (They remember when we were still Vivids...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right now, I... I can't sing...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I want to be able to again... Someday...

rows.Speaker: Live House Staff A
rows.Line: No, you don't need to apologize.

rows.Speaker: Live House Staff A
rows.Line: That being said... It is unfortunate.

rows.Speaker: Live House Staff A
rows.Line: I mean, you were An's first partner.

rows.Speaker: Live House Staff B
rows.Line:
Sorry for keeping you.
Don't stay out too late, okay?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Is it okay for me to tell her?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (That I want to get a lot better...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (That I want us to sing together again someday.)

rows.Speaker: Audience Member B
rows.Line: Yeah! She stands head and shoulders above everyone else her age.

rows.Speaker: Audience Member B
rows.Line: At the same time, I feel like she's sort of lost her step.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (It still felt like I couldn't sing with everything I had.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(This has been happening a lot recently.
I keep singing and singing, but feel like I'm missing something.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
It's okay, Kohane.
You don't need to apologize...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I should've done more to protect you back there...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
But...!
I promise to look after you from now on!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'll make sure you can have the confidence to sing without any fear!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, Kohane... Let's keep singing together!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I really, really appreciate everything you just said.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And I do really want to keep singing with you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I want to keep on chasing after that dream with you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm so...scared of performing on stage again...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Then there's no way I can keep singing with you...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Which means I can't surpass that legendary event with you...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Kohane's too afraid to sing right now.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Even if I tell her that everything's gonna be okay and force her back on stage...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (She'll just end up suffering even more.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I want you to make your dream come true.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Because I really love the way you sing.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I genuinely believe that you have what it takes to surpass that legendary event.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'll make it happen, for sure.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (It's too selfish of me to keep hoping that she'll come back around.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (It's my fault for dragging her into this mess. She wouldn't have gotten hurt if I hadn't asked her to sing with me.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What am I doing?
I shouldn't be acting all mopey after a show.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I already apologized to her about making her perform on stage like that, so there's nothing more I can do to change things.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I made a promise to Kohane.
I said that I'm gonna make my dream come true.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I have to keep moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Hey, welcome back.
How'd your event go today?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... It was fun, but it could've gone better.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You seem to be struggling a bit.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Every time I sing, I feel like I'm missing something.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Like I'm not going all out, you know...?
I'm not singing with everything I have.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Is she still on your mind?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: It's only natural for you to think about her.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: After all, she was the partner you'd been looking for for so long.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know I have to keep moving forward.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know that I have to move on from Kohane.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I think I'm never going to find a partner who's as good as her.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Which means... I have to keep singing by myself.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I have to surpass RAD WEEKEND on my own...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You still have your whole life ahead of you. It's too soon for you to be giving up.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And I want to believe that, but—

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Did you hear a voice just now, Dad?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Why do I feel so anxious all of a sudden?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I feel like I've forgotten something really important...)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: When I say you're too young to be giving up, I'm not just talking about finding a new partner.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Which means you can't force her to perform with you again. Even if you could, it wouldn't be right.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: As long as she hasn't started to hate singing, there's still a chance of her coming back.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: That's what I was referring to when I said it's too soon to give up.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: But given that... There's no telling what's going to happen even if you wait for her to return.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: That may end up being more painful than giving up on her for good.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I've been running circles in my head thinking about how I forced Kohane to help make my dream come true.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But that day... When I heard her sing...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I got the feeling that singing also meant a lot to her.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Which is why I think she hasn't started hating it...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, I guess there still is a chance of her coming back, right?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
It's a “no comment” from me.
I mean, you know your partner the best.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I feel like I know what I need to do now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'll be fine! I mean, I'm just going to my usual spot!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: She still isn't fully back on her feet, but she seems resolved at least.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I know this is a long shot.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (By clinging to this, I might end up feeling really disappointed.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I might wait and wait...and come out of this completely empty-handed.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I've made the decision to keep singing here.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (In the hopes that I'll get Kohane's attention again!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, what is it that you need to tell me?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: For belittling your dream the way I did.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What's gotten into you all of a sudden...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I know I should have apologized much sooner.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And I don't expect you to forgive me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I've wanted to do this for quite a while now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You've wanted to apologize to me...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then, that time, why did you...?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I know you had a lot going on.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Is that all you wanted to say...?
If so, I'm gonna—

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Did you also hear them, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, but I couldn't make out what they were saying.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Could it have been people singing...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I don't actually know for sure, but...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You can leave if you want.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Someone's been singing for a while now...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I think it's coming from over here...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It's like she's screaming, calling out to someone out of reach.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Akito? What are you doing here...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Whoa, you really startled me there! It's been forever!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I heard that you're over in the US now. What brought you back?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I had a thing to go to.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Also, I didn't know you were still singing...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What? Of course I'm still singing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, I'm going to surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I guess your confidence hasn't wavered.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But that's not going to happen...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Because I'm going to surpass that night.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Then, let's throw down right here.
That's the easiest way to set the record straight.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I think it's coming from over here...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (He must've been training pretty hard, but...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But I'm not about to let her win!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I can tell that they're throwing everything they have at each other.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I want to sing with them right this second.)
What do you think your true feelings are, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(I have no idea...
But it sounded like words of support someone gave me a really, really long time ago...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (That I want to be more courageous.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I want to become stronger than everyone else...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I can't stay by his side if I don't fully commit.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (That's why I decided to give up music for good.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (How was I able to spend all this time without singing?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I knew it... You still love music more than anything.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Singing with her fills me with so much joy and excitement...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Why do I feel so excited all of a sudden?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(It's like when I'm singing with Akito...
No, this sensation goes far beyond that.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (The four of us are singing together for the first time, so why are we meshing together so—)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Yeah, now I get it.
But none of that matters right now.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Man, that was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But also, what's the meaning of all this?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Is this something SEKAI wants us to see?
Or am I just dreaming...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
A dream...
What if we're all having the same dream?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I still don't really understand what's going on, but talk about a weird dream.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's hard to believe that we forgot everything we went through together.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah...
But I'm glad we all remembered in the end.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Even if this world isn't real...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The thought of not being able to sing with you is just too much to bear, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! I feel the same way!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, there's no way one person is ever gonna be able to surpass RAD WEEKEND all by themselves.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Speaking of which, you're not allowed to disappear like that again.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'm sorry.
But I'm also glad that I remember everything now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The time I spent with you, Akito, everything we experienced as Vivid BAD SQUAD and just how much our music means to us.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, so... How do we get out of here?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I can't seem to find “Untitled” on my phone.
I was hoping that we could contact Miku and the others...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, it's not on my phone either...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
So many questions...
But for now, wanna head over to the cafe? We can think about this situation more there.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That sounds good. It's been so long since I last had Ken's coffee.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But if this is all a dream, is it gonna taste the same?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm so glad that the four of us are back together.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Because singing means everything to me now.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(And the dream An gave me...
My dream that everyone helped grow into something much bigger...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I need to make sure to never forget it again.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I want to keep chasing after the same dream with them.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Thank goodness! You guys are finally back to normal!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You were all completely unresponsive for quite some time.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, it was as if your minds were somewhere else entirely...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We tried to get you all to snap out of it, but nothing we did seemed to work.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Can you tell us what you remember?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
So...
I remember us talking about how there was something wrong with the tree in the plaza...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, and we were discussing how we could remove all those black fragments.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! We were worried that it'd keep getting sicker...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. And those fragments have all changed color...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The tree just seemed to absorb all of them at once.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, the leaves look so full of life now!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I think those black flecks were all fragments of feelings.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Did you see something after you touched them?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And it felt so real. But it was like a different reality...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Umm... How should we explain it?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So it was a dream about how your lives would've turned out if you'd all made different choices.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Imagine if they all really became separated and never saw each other ever again...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It was all just a dream.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. Fortunately, we were somehow able to reunite with one another in the end.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Based on what you all just told us...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Your feelings may've created those black fragments.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes. Pain, doubt, internal conflict...
Those are all just as much a part of your feelings.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They must've been lingering within SEKAI all this time. And they found their way onto the tree.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, then... The tree became “sick” because of our feelings?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Like Miku just said, those negative emotions are all a part of who you are.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, and you all found a way to turn them into something beautiful in the end!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Which means you all provided the tree with the nutrients it required to keep growing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see...
When you put it that way, I suppose it wasn't all bad.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, it's normal to experience some pain while trying desperately to reach the top.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But... I'm kinda happy that happened, you know?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. I know that dream was full of not-so-nice things...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But we managed to overcome those hurdles and sing as a team again, remember?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, doesn't that mean we'll be able to handle anything that comes our way?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I believe that you'll be able to overcome any obstacles that you encounter and propel yourself to new heights.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And you'll likely grow a staggering amount with each passing challenge.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're not gonna stop until we stand on top of the world.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. And we'll need to take on everything that comes our way if we want to make that happen.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, we've already overcome a lot until now!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, let's keep charging ahead... Together!
